jobs.title: About Us
jobs.description: Who We Are Defense and intelligence professionals, building the video intelligence platform we wished we'd had in the field. We aim to supercharge how governments, businesses, and communities protect more people and more assets - transforming surveillance from passive watching to active intelligence and limitless clarity. Each of us have experienced firsthand the frustration of critical moments buried in endless footage, and operators forced to adapt to rigid, outdated tools rather than the other way around. CONNTOUR EXISTS BECAUSE "GOOD ENOUGH" DOESN'T SAVE LIVES. We combined deep expertise in defense, AI, and computer vision to build the platform we wished we'd had in the field - one that understands intent, acts with urgency, and gives teams the clarity to act before it's too late. Our Values The principles we don't negotiate on. 01 / PROTECT WHAT MATTERS Everything we build exists for one purpose: safeguarding people and the environments they depend on. 02 / BRING CLARITY TO CHAOS Complexity is inevitable. Confusion is not. We turn overwhelming data into clarity that's immediate and actionable. 03 / MISSION GRADE STANDARDS When the stakes are this high, good enough doesn't exist. We hold ourselves to the standards we learned in the field — where precision and reliability aren't aspirations, they're requirements. 04 / OPERATORS FIRST We build for the people on the front lines. Every feature, every interface, and every decision is measured against one question: does this make the operator's job faster, clearer, and their environment safer? Trusted by government agencies and enterprises globally, we're driven by a single conviction: The people responsible for protecting others deserve tools as sharp as their instincts. A new era of video intelligence. See how Conntour helps mission-critical teams search, monitor, and analyze video using natural language. CONTACT US

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: In this role Interested? Send your resume and a short note about why you want to join Conntour. APPLY NOW About Conntour Conntour is a defense-tech startup backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, including YC, General Catalyst, and SV Angel. We are building the next generation of defense-tech autonomous systems, connecting distributed camera networks, AI models, and natural-language interfaces to surface mission-critical insights in real time. Our platform is already protecting sensitive sites for private and government agencies, and we’re just getting started. The Impact You’ll Make As a Senior Backend Engineer at Conntour, you’ll be one of the first engineers shaping the foundation of our platform. You’ll design and build high-scale, performance-critical backend systems that power real-time video and AI-driven workflows in high-stakes environments. Your work will directly influence our architecture, infrastructure, deployment strategy, and engineering standards from the ground up. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves building robust systems, optimizing performance, owning infrastructure, and solving hard problems where reliability and speed matter. What You’ll Do Design, build, and own high-performance backend services for real-time, mission-critical systems. Develop scalable data pipelines for camera networks, video streams, AI/ML outputs, and operational insights. Build systems optimized for low latency, high throughput, reliability, and resilience. Own backend architecture decisions across APIs, databases, infrastructure, observability, and deployment. Work closely with ML, product, frontend, and design teams to translate complex AI outputs into reliable product experiences. Build and maintain production infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, and modern DevOps practices. Improve performance across the stack, including API response times, data processing, database access, and real-time event handling. Help design systems that can run both in cloud environments and on-premises / edge deployments. Set engineering standards around code quality, testing, deployment, observability, and operational excellence. Contribute to the technical roadmap of a platform built to operate in demanding, real-world environments. Who You Are 5+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with strong backend ownership. Experienced in building high-scale, production-grade distributed systems. Strong understanding of system design, performance optimization, reliability, and scalability. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and production operations. Comfortable owning infrastructure and DevOps responsibilities, not just application code. Experienced with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. Strong API design skills and experience building reliable service-to-service architectures. Able to move fast while maintaining high standards for stability, security, and maintainability. Product-minded, proactive, accountable, and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment. Passionate about building technology with real-world consequences. Computer science degree Bonus Points For Strong Python experience, especially with FastAPI or similar backend frameworks. Experience with real-time video systems, streaming pipelines, or distributed camera networks. Experience with computer vision, ML infrastructure, LLMs, vector databases, or AI agents. Experience deploying and managing on-premises or edge systems. Experience with GPU-based workloads, inference pipelines, or NVIDIA DeepStream. Experience designing systems that operate under strict latency, bandwidth, or hardware constraints. Background in defense-tech, security, robotics, autonomous systems, or physical-world AI. Prior startup experience, especially in early-stage or 0→1 environments. Experience working closely with design and product teams to build intuitive technical workflows. Why Conntour Cutting-edge technology Work on real-time vision models, multimodal AI, distributed video systems, and fast operational interfaces. Mission with impact Your systems will help protect lives and critical infrastructure in Israel and beyond. Ownership from day one Join as one of the first 10 employees and help shape the architecture, infrastructure, engineering culture, and technical direction of the company. Hard problems, real users Build systems that need to perform reliably in complex, high-stakes, real-world environments. We move fast, care deeply, and are looking for teammates who do the same. Join us — let’s build something that matters. A new era of video intelligence. See how Conntour helps mission-critical teams search, monitor, and analyze video using natural language. CONTACT US
